insight: Raised $400M in June 2026 at a $5.4B valuation, more than doubling its value in seven months.
name: Suno
tagline: Full songs from a prompt. Vocals, instruments, structure.
description: Hosted music generation with vocal performances, instrument arrangement, and song structure baked in. Type a description or upload a hook, get a finished track. Defined the prompt-to-song category.

changelog.summary: Recategorized from audio to the new dedicated music-generation category.

edge: Defined prompt-to-song and leads on vocal quality plus song structure, with native iOS/Android apps rivals lack.
pros: Realistic vocals and full song structure
Native mobile apps, not just web
cons: Trained on copyrighted music; active lawsuits
Commercial rights only on paid tiers

references.title: Still facing copyright lawsuits, AI music generator Suno raises another $400M
